[NOTICE] This game will become Redfield Elementary 2 before December.

👋 Welcome to Redfield Elementary School! 🐦

Choose your role, explore campus, and make your mark at Redfield! 🎒🏫 Relax at the beach, visit neighborhoods, decorate your home, and ride the school bus across Scottsdale. Ready to start your Redfield journey? 🌟📚

🎒 Play as Student, Teacher, Principal, Security, Nurse, and more!
🏠 Customize cozy homes, apartments, and penthouses!
🚙 Cruise through the city in your own vehicle!
🌈 Raise a family and enjoy every moment together!

🌵 We are based on a real elementary school in Scottsdale, Arizona! Created by a former student!

⭐ Join our group to stay updated with RFES news!
👍 Don't forget to leave a like to support our school!
